vocabulary.definition: people who enter a place without permission, especially when this is done with force
vocabulary.example: The security system is designed to keep intruders out of the building.

vocabulary.definition: a million raised to the power of five (10^18)
vocabulary.example: The number of stars in the universe is estimated to be in the quintillions.

vocabulary.definition: a process whereby something, typically information or knowledge, is successively passed on
vocabulary.example: The cascades of events that followed the initial decision led to a major crisis.

vocabulary.definition: the action or process of making something stronger or more extreme
vocabulary.example: The speaker system in the concert hall allowed for the amplification of sound to reach every corner.

vocabulary.definition: a type of cell within the body capable of engulfing and absorbing bacteria and other small cells and particles
vocabulary.example: Phagocytes play a crucial role in the body's immune response by consuming harmful pathogens.

vocabulary.definition: a thin, pliable sheet or layer of material that acts as a boundary, lining, or partition
vocabulary.example: The membrane of the cell regulates the passage of substances in and out of the cell.
